principle_violations.reason: The Order class is handling both order details and order status management, which are considered two distinct responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of maintaining order details and order status into two different classes.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class is dependent on the concrete Order class and directly modifies its state, which violates the DIP principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface for order status management and have the Order class implement it. The PaymentProcessor should depend on this interface.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
